text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the Tracen Academy dorms, a day is

designated for the residents to gather
and put
their dirty laundry out for
collection.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The staff then put the clothing into large
bags for
transportation.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's time to put your laundry out! Here's
your
chance if you've forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fuji! Miho Dorm just got done, so
the staff
will be comin' our way soon!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we'll need to hurry then. Today
looks like
quite the load.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Though... I'm impressed looking at these
big bags
of clothing. They're a visual
reminder of
everyone's hard work.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You may have a point. Mud stains and

sweat-soaked gym clothes are real
symbols of
havin' gone through the
wringer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's as if these bags are full of everyone's
efforts
toward their dreams...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sure hope they pay off someday.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, here comes your motherly side
again. That
face tells all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You should have a look at yourself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Anyways, don'tcha think you
should include
yourself in that picture?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're a student just like the rest of us
tryna
make our dreams come true!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I can't argue with you there.
